name: com.pancakedevs.apexphysics
description: A PC-first Unity physics framework for grounded physical NPC locomotion, natural procedural walking, momentum-preserving ragdolls, editor-generated destruction, synchronized water volumes, Rigidbody buoyancy, currents, input-agnostic swimming, grabbable objects, barcode-driven crates with Void previews, built-in package updates, navigation, lighting workflows, and reusable physics gameplay. VR character support is planned after the desktop character foundation is stable.

samples.description: Starter content for testing Apex physics components.
Optional URP low-poly water shader with depth color, foam, caustics, and refraction.
